cohort: 100 term neonates admitted to the Inborn and Outborn NICU at Mallareddy Institute of Medical Sciences, Hyderabad, Telangana, India.
finding: Caesarean extraction was significantly associated with respiratory distress (RD), and the frequency of RD was inversely related to gestational age and birth weight.
mod_finding: Caesarean extraction was significantly associated with respiratory distress.
birth_weight: Not specified, but birth weight was inversely associated with respiratory distress
